title: Hearing on homeownership bills covering co-ops, deed theft and taxes
summary: The Council's Finance and Housing and Buildings Committees held a joint hearing on homeownership issues, including testimony from HPD, DOB and DOF. The hearing covered several bills such as co-op board training requirements, education on the housing choice voucher homeownership program, a new homebuyer financial assistance program, automatic enrollment in property tax payment plans, and reporting on building violation enforcement disparities. It also addressed resolutions urging Albany to pass state legislation on housing development fund companies, homeowner tax exemptions and a statewide fair housing act.
